android.desc:
Weawow is a free weather app with comparable multiple weather providers, animated weather map and radar, highly customizable layout and widgets, and beautiful weather photos from around the world.
There are no ads and no tracking. Weawow delivers only the weather information you need, in the most comfortable way.


WOW WEATHER EXPERIENCE

The weather photos reflect the actual weather conditions of each location, allowing you to visually understand whether it is sunny, cloudy, rainy, or snowy.
A golden sunset, a quiet snowy landscape, moving clouds—these scenes bring a sense of calm.
Through this WOW experience, Weawow aims to connect people and contribute to a more peaceful world.


COMPARE WEATHER FORECASTS

Modern forecasting technology has improved significantly, especially for short-term predictions within the next few hours. However, forecasts can still differ in unstable weather conditions.
With Weawow, you can compare weather forecasts from multiple weather providers side by side in an easy-to-understand graphs, helping you make more confident decisions.
For example:
- If most providers say “no rain,” you can leave your umbrella at home
- If forecasts differ, you can prepare for both possibilities

Supported providers:
NWS (NOAA), DWD, Meteo France, AEMET, MET Norway, Apple Weather, Xweather, Weatherbit, World Weather Online, OpenWeather
AccuWeather and Foreca are available via donation (one-time donation unlocks them permanently)


WEATHER DATA

Check detailed weather data with hourly forecasts and up to 14-day daily forecasts (depends on provider).
- Temperature, feels-like, precipitation, chance of rain, wind, gusts, pressure, humidity, dew point, clouds, UV index, visibility, snowfall, solar radiation
- Air quality: AQI, PM2.5, PM10, NO2, SO2, CO, ozone (Data Source: CAMS, ECMWF)
- Official severe weather alerts
- Pollen (only AccuWeather and USA)

Also includes sunrise, sunset, golden hour, blue hour, and moon phase with animations for up to one month.
Useful for photography timing.


WEATHER MAP & RADAR

View global weather on a smooth animated globe.
- Precipitation, radar, temperature, humidity, dew point, clouds, snow, air quality
- Wind animation
- Pressure isobars
- Forecast up to 14 days


SIMPLE INTERFACE

- You can get the necessary information by simply scrolling down. Tap each section to see more details.
- You can bookmark the favorite weather locations, and change them by swiping left
